quest.title: Neko Is a Cat: Shrine Canteen
quest.description: Neko, "Provisional Head Priestess of the Asase Shrine," seems to have business with you...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x100, Primogem x20, Mora x10000

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: When we began, that stone did not look a thing like me. But with each passing glance, it becomes more and more so.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: It is very noisy, yes, but I am the provisional head priestess. Such trivial matters are not worth complaining about.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Bring these fish to that tall human.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: They are good things, and may be considered his... "celery."

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Meow, I did get Konbumaru to lead those children to try to catch some finches, but it did not turn out very well.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: For them, catching fish is still simpler.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Meow meow meow, how bothersome of you.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Just give them to him — they are good things, after all.

talks.objective: Bring the Fish to Ooshima Junpei

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: Well, this certainly looks the part now...

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: Haha, it's you. Do you think it looks a bit more like the Lady Priestess now?

response.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
response.text: Right? Ah, I spent a few days burning the midnight oil on this, too...

response.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
response.text: Ah, I'm pretty hungry, I think... Time to go look for something to eat again...

response.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
response.text: Hmm, well, the Lady Priestess has my thanks, but uh... I think I'll look for food on my own...

response.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
response.text: I've eaten fish for several straight days now. I don't think I could eat any more...

response.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
response.text: I've been heading out to forage for food. When I'm lucky, I can grab a finch or a pigeon...

response.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
response.text: *sigh* But what I'd like to have is some meat, you know? Some firm, juicy meat...

response.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
response.text: If you don't mind, could you get me three servings of Raw Meat?

response.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
response.text: I'm no good at hunting, so I haven't been able to get any meat these past few days... So please, give me a hand!

response.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
response.text: Please help me out. Just three servings will do!

choices.text: Did you think of going back to Narukami Island to have a meal?

response.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
response.text: Well, it's really far away, for one thing. And for another... I was just getting the hang of this carving. If I'd left at this point, the journey might have deprived me of that "feeling," see.

response.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
response.text: I'd prefer to eat a quick meal here before continuing to carve.

choices.text: It's a lot larger, that's for sure.

response.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
response.text: Well, of course. The Lady Priestess is quite a bit larger than your average cat, but if you want a more majestic statue, then it's got to be even larger still. This is a shrine statue, after all!

talks.objective: Give Ooshima Junpei three servings of Raw Meat

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: Ooh... the marbling... Thank you both so much!

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: I'll whip up a few good dishes in just a moment. With any luck, I might even finish my carving faster after eating, haha!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What do the two have in common, again?

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: Eating some good meat gives you the strength to keep going! It just wasn't the same with those fish. I couldn't help but feel like my hands were too weak for the work...

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: Honestly, I was starting to get worried that I might take longer than expected to finish the whole statue. Well, that's not a problem now, thanks to you!

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: I mean, I am being employed by a... cat, sure, but one should always avoid asking for extensions.

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: Whatever the case, I'll get this one done as soon as I can... Come to think of it, the Lady Priestess said that once the statue is completed, something good will happen.

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: I'm not sure what that means exactly, but well... I'm quite looking forward to it, actually.

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: Come back in a while and have a look at the final product.

talks.objective: Give Ooshima Junpei three servings of Raw Meat

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: How did it go? Were you able to get the Raw Meat?
